title: Jamie Burkart portfolio blind-spot controls
objective: Turn the portfolio's known evidence, audience, outcome, visual, and maintenance blind spots into observable criteria without allowing an agent to fabricate human review or market response.
hard_constraints: An agent may not invent collaborator approval, hiring-reader observations, references, interviews, application outcomes, analytics, or photo rights.
A protocol is not evidence that the human activity occurred.
Public artifacts may not expose private correspondence, contact lists, applicant data, audience identities, private analytics, or uncleared media.
Action-to-outcome chains must distinguish Jamie's work, team or movement work, institutional action, and observed result.
The public website remains a selective projection of the knowledge bank rather than a complete mirror of it.

evals.title: Collaborator corroboration and independent collective-credit review
evals.blind_spot: The archive contains strong records but too little exact-candidate review by people who participated in collective work.
pass_criteria: At least two independent reviewers assess the exact candidate's collective-credit and role language.
At least one relevant collaborator confirms, complicates, or corrects each promoted role claim that currently depends primarily on Jamie's recollection.
Corrections, disagreements, permission limits, and not-observed areas remain visible.
AI-assisted archival notes are never represented as collaborator testimony.
evals.stopping_boundary: Stop human-blocked until real reviews of the exact candidate are recorded.

evals.title: First-screen hiring conversion and decisive role fit
evals.blind_spot: A reader may admire the work without knowing what role to hire Jamie for or what he will make usable.
pass_criteria: The first viewport names Technical Project Manager, Product Operations, and Implementation.
The first viewport names Jamie's action, concrete work products, and the practical end served.
Selected work, resume, and contact actions are immediately available.
Emergence and transition are framed as normal working conditions rather than organizational failure or shame.
evals.stopping_boundary: Do not add more homepage claims when clearer selection or sequencing will solve the problem.

evals.title: Current professional evidence and forward trajectory
evals.blind_spot: Historical work can overshadow Jamie's current technical, product-operations, data, and AI-evaluation practice.
pass_criteria: At least four governed proof records establish substantive 2025-2026 work or professional development.
The evidence spans implementation, data or knowledge systems, and AI evaluation rather than relying on a credential alone.
Current experiments remain distinguished from completed client delivery or production software.
The current role family is explicit across the homepage, resume, and Technical Operations page.
evals.stopping_boundary: Do not turn a proposal, lab, course, or working corpus into an unearned production-delivery claim.

evals.title: Observed hiring-reader comprehension and market response
evals.blind_spot: Internal evals cannot establish what recruiters and hiring managers actually notice, misunderstand, or act upon.
pass_criteria: At least five independent hiring readers complete the same timed comprehension tasks against the exact candidate.
At least two readers have hiring or recruiting experience relevant to technical project management, implementation, product operations, or civic technology.
The record separates observed behavior from participant interpretation and optimization history.
A bounded application sample records response patterns without publishing employer, contact, compensation, or private correspondence data.
evals.stopping_boundary: Stop human-blocked until real reader sessions and a bounded market-feedback sample exist.

evals.title: Action-to-outcome chains for the three lead case studies
evals.blind_spot: Artifacts and public outcomes can sit near each other without establishing Jamie's specific action or the boundary between contribution and causation.
pass_criteria: Exactly three lead chains name context, Jamie's action, work product, observable result, and source-backed boundary.
Every proof and claim identifier resolves.
Collective and institutional outcomes remain distinct from Jamie's contribution.
No chain substitutes chronology, platform metrics, or adjacent policy outcomes for causation.
evals.stopping_boundary: Hold or soften a result when the causal bridge is not independently supported.

evals.title: Rights-aware visual evidence on lead work
evals.blind_spot: The portfolio describes materially and relationally rich work but currently exposes no rights-cleared project-image set.
pass_criteria: At least three lead case studies contain a genuine project image or inspectable visual artifact.
Every selected visual has subject, date or bounded chronology, project context, photographer, rights holder, permission status, consent status, alt text, and caption.
The visual demonstrates a specific work condition, artifact, interaction, or result rather than supplying atmosphere.
Uncleared media remains outside the public repository and website.
evals.stopping_boundary: Stop human-blocked until an editor selects material and rights and consent are cleared.

evals.title: Knowledge-bank maintenance and drift visibility
evals.blind_spot: A deep knowledge bank can become difficult to maintain unless staleness, unresolved claims, orphan records, and target-role coverage stay visible.
pass_criteria: A reproducible report inventories sources, assertions, claims, proof records, research tasks, held claims, contradictions, and stale reviews.
Every identifier reference resolves and every intake-linked source is decomposed into at least one atomic assertion.
The report names the review-age policy and never treats a held or not-recovered claim as publication-ready.
Technical project management, product operations, implementation, data or knowledge systems, and AI evaluation each retain governed proof coverage.
evals.stopping_boundary: A maintenance report may expose work to do; it must not rewrite claims or approve projections automatically.
